closure_rule: These eight entry contracts and nine abstract primitive effect classes are the entire permitted design universe, not nine proven machine functions. Every future explicit/implicit machine call must refine one class and have source-backed complete effects. No arbitrary SQL parser, stored body interpreter, user-defined operator/type I/O/default/support function, SECURITY DEFINER transition, dynamic loader callback, arbitrary object lookup, write or external process may be reachable. Unknown call rejects before source effects/publication. Existing native source identity and approved bridge primitives remain separately bound by their frozen manifests.
